spells.name: Renew Armor
spells.description: Refreshes Barrier, Protection, Stone Skin, Mana Shield and Mana Surge on the caster in one cast - along with their Ultra versions, if learned. Any of the five not yet learned are simply skipped.

spells.name: Ultra Mana Surge
spells.description: A far stronger Mana Surge, increasing the target's elemental powers by twice as much. Learning it does not replace Mana Surge - a caster who knows both keeps the benefit of each.

spells.name: Emberheart Resolve
spells.description: Hardens the caster or an ally with a fire-forged resolve, boosting fire resistance, armor class, and vitality.

spells.name: Cinderburst
spells.description: Detonates a searing burst of fire around the target, scorching anyone caught nearby.
spells.targetNote: Targets must be alive, in range and permitted by combat/line-of-sight rules.

spells.name: Ultra Protection
spells.description: A far stronger Protection, increasing the target's armor class by twice as much. Learning it does not replace Protection - a caster who knows both keeps the benefit of each.

spells.name: Ultra Stone Skin
spells.description: A far stronger Stone Skin, increasing the target's armor class by twice as much. Learning it does not replace Stone Skin - a caster who knows both keeps the benefit of each.

spells.name: Riptide Surge
spells.description: Slams a single foe with a crushing surge of water, scaling with the caster's intelligence.
spells.targetNote: The primary target takes full damage; enemies on adjacent tiles (including diagonals) take 25% damage. Eight targets maximum, with line of sight and combat restrictions.

spells.name: Drowned Ward
spells.description: Wraps the caster or an ally in a tide-blessed ward, raising water and dark resistance along with armor class.

spells.name: Ultra Barrier
spells.description: A far stronger Barrier, increasing the target's armor class by twice as much. Learning it does not replace Barrier - a caster who knows both keeps the benefit of each.

spells.name: Ultra Mana Shield
spells.description: A far stronger Mana Shield, increasing the target's elemental resistances by twice as much. Learning it does not replace Mana Shield - a caster who knows both keeps the benefit of each.

spells.name: Veilstone Aegis
spells.description: Wraps the target in a shimmering veil, granting bonuses to air, water, earth, fire and dark resistance as well as armor class.

spells.name: Wellspring Mercy
spells.description: Calls forth a wave of divine mercy, greatly restoring health to the caster and any nearby grouped allies.
spells.targetNote: Configured with an area radius, but the current game applies this support spell to the caster only; group healing is not implemented.

spells.name: Leyward Bastion
spells.description: Raises a standing ward around the caster's party, granting bonuses to air, water, earth, fire and dark resistance as well as armor class.

spells.name: Dawnwell Renewal
spells.description: Calls up a wellspring of dawnlight, greatly restoring health to the caster and any nearby grouped allies.
spells.targetNote: Configured with an area radius, but the current game applies this support spell to the caster only; group healing is not implemented.
